# mongodb_app_services_app (Data Source)

Looks up an Atlas App Services app by name or client App ID, for its ObjectID (`id`), which `mongodb_app_services_function` and `mongodbatlas_event_trigger` take as `app_id`. Needs `atlas_public_key` and `atlas_private_key` in the provider block.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Triggers made in the Atlas UI live in an app of product type "atlas".
data "mongodb_app_services_app" "triggers" {
  project_id = var.atlas_project_id
  name       = "Triggers"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) The Atlas project ID.

### Optional

- `client_app_id` (String) The client App ID shown in the Atlas UI, e.g. `triggers-abcde`. Set this or `name`.
- `name` (String) App name. Set this or `client_app_id`.
- `product` (String) The app's product type: `standard`, `atlas` (the app behind triggers made in the Atlas UI), `data-api` or `device-sync`. All types are searched when unset.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The app's ObjectID.
